'''John Groman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 8th at [[February 2001 Findlay tournament]] on 17 February 2001 with Cloud City beats and Cloud City mains, according to Brad Eier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1737">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-17-findlay-ohio-2-17-01d1737/ findlay-ohio-2-17-01], DeckTech (brad "swccguy" eier, 17 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-17-findlay-ohio-2-17-01d1737/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
